content.title: Contact Us
content.summary: For emergencies, residents should call 911, while non-emergency police matters can be reported at 303-980-7300. Service requests can be submitted online 24/7 and are addressed during regular business hours. City Hall is located at 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002, and the main phone number is 720-898-7000.
content.body:
**For emergencies, call 911.**For non-emergency police matters, please call 303-980-7300.

## Submit a Service Request

[Submit a service request or report a concern](https://seeclickfix.com/web_portal/m96AzqbgQ9RW9z5CcqFqEwP8/issues/map) 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Requests are monitored and addressed during regular business hours Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.

## City Hall

**Main Phone**: 720-898-7000  
**Address**: 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002

## Contact a Department

If you need to contact a department directly (or just find out more about them), you can find their phone number and detailed department information in the [Department Directory](/149).
